display.summary: Document files: one pipeline for upload, scan, page editing and history, with images as PDF pages.
highlights: register_document_file(Model, "pdf_file") connects the file card, Scan, viewer, page editor, downloads and file history for a field, with permission and scope checks.
JPG, JPEG, PNG, TIF, TIFF and WebP become PDF pages; pages can be rotated and fitted to A4 in the editor.
The PDF editor scans through ScanLink like the file card; file history lives in DjangoLux (dlux.FileVersion) and dlux_adopt_file_history moves a project's own rows over.
Includes 1.12.0b1: deleting keeps history (soft bulk delete, history-safe user deletion).
